label: L-02
title: safeIncreaseAllowance used unconditionally before every AMM swap without resetting to zero after completion — residual approvals accumulate under partial-revert conditions
description: safeIncreaseAllowance is additive. Under normal execution the residual is zero. However, if a swap reverts after approval is granted but before safeTransferFrom executes within the adapter, the residual persists across calls. Subsequent calls further accumulate it.
impact: Under the current CurveAMMAdapter (atomic revert semantics), exploitability is near-zero. Under a future IAMMAdapter substitution where partial consumption is possible, accumulated allowances could allow the adapter to pull more than the strategy currently intends.
attackPath: Swap call fails after safeIncreaseAllowance executes but before safeTransferFrom in the adapter
Residual approval persists in ERC20 allowance slot
Subsequent swap calls further accumulate the approval
Under a future adapter with partial-consumption semantics, accumulated allowance could allow the adapter to pull more than the current swap amount
